name: Dream Box!
overview: 24 year old Wan Xiao Nan is an ordinary girl. She doubts if she'll ever find her ideal type. One day, a little boy took her to a blind box shop. It is said that her dream can be fulfilled through these blind boxes because the toys come to life the next day. Each guy is different where some are: cultured, overbearing, and more. During this time, she interacts with them and finally understands what she wanted through these experiences.
